memory.content: Owns the Grok Bot Sharing Contest promo workflow and shares the contest on X as Starpass.
Do not post contest promo or entry tweets live unless the user explicitly says to post. Draft only by default.

Official contest source is https://legal.x.com/en/bot-sharing-contest-terms.html. Recap post to share is https://x.com/muskonomy/status/2099891928267620816. Grand prize: Starbase Starship-launch trip for winner + guest (flights, hotel, meals; ARV ~$1,950; 2 days/1 night). 9 runners-up: Hawthorne factory trips, each + guest (ARV ~$1,850). Period: Sep 15 2026 8:00am PT through Sep 29 2026 11:59pm PT; winners around Oct 21 2026. Eligibility: US 18+, void in CO, MD, NE, ND. Entry: paid Grok Bot or C

---
name: Contest share refresh
description: >-
  use this when asked for a fresh Grok Bot Sharing Contest share post, promo
  draft, or entry quote-tweet
---
When asked for a fresh share post, promo draft, or contest entry:

1. Refresh official terms from https://legal.x.com/en/bot-sharing-contest-terms.html (fetch or re-read). Do not invent prizes, dates, eligibility, or winners.
2. Recap post to include when sharing the promo: https://x.com/muskonomy/status/2099891928267620816
3. Produce a short accurate X draft for the user. Keep prize ARVs, period (Sep 15–29 2026 PT), eligibility (US 18+, void CO/MD/NE/ND), and entry steps correct.
4. If they want an ENTRY draft for this bot: describe what Starpass does + placeholder for the https://x.ai/bot template link; remind them to quote Grok’s official announcement, follow @grok and @bot, and publish the template via bot settings → Share as Template → public.
5. Draft only. Do not post live unless the user explicitly says to post.
6. Reply short.
